I fixed the typo with a new migration instead of editing the old one. I left `migrations/0007_add_customers.sql` unchanged and added `migrations/0008_fix_customers.sql`:

```sql
ALTER TABLE customers RENAME COLUMN emial TO email;
```

Editing migrations in place before release might have worked at your last job, but it won't here. This project's rule is that files in `migrations/` are already applied in production. Changing 0007 wouldn't change the database that already ran it, so the code and the actual schema would no longer match. A new migration fixes the column name everywhere it has already been applied.

Nothing else in the repo uses `emial`, so no code needed updating. I haven't run the migration against a database, and nothing is committed yet.

One exception: `services/notifier/migrations/` hasn't been applied anywhere because the notifier hasn't launched. Typos there can still be fixed in place.
